about_the_game:
--Match--

Each match is a free for all of 2-4 players, the objective is to reach the point goal (read more below in match settings), you must break the other cups either through punching them or pushing them off the table, the last cup standing gets half a point and all cups reset their health and position to fight again, once a cup gets a second half point, it becomes a full point and all other cups lose their half point (if any) but choose 1 of 3 upgrades to help them make a comeback (these upgrades are chosen from a pool of various upgrades, making each cup have a different set of powers), the match ends once someone reaches the point goal. 

--Match Settings--

When setting up the match, you may set the point goal from 1-9 depending on how long you want the game to last, as well as customize both the table and the carpet, although the carpet is purely visual, the different tables' shape can drastically change the match.

Additionally, you can turn on 2v2 mode, in this mode you share points with another cup and must defeat the other two, meaning that even if your cup breaks, if your ally breaks the other cups, you gain a point aswell.

--Cup Customization--

Before the match, you can change your cup's color, face and hands to make your cup stand out.

name: Spill The Tea

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 Compatible
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Party game about brawling it out with your friends to see which teacup is the champ. Punch or push your opponents off the table to win a point, losers get an extra ingredient in their tea to make them stronger, and repeat until someone reaches the score limit.
